examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Multi-select over a flat option list; one option is pre-selected through v-model.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The three trigger sizes (small, medium, large) matching Input.

examples.name: Groups
examples.summary: Options organised into labelled sections via MultiSelectGroup.

examples.name: WithSearchAndFooter
examples.summary: The search and footer slots on MultiSelectContent: a filterable list with a footer action that appends a new option.

examples.name: WithOptionExtras
examples.summary: Per-option extras on MultiSelectItem: a leading icon, a custom left slot, and a trailing tag.

examples.name: LongList
examples.summary: A long option list; the panel scrolls internally once it exceeds its max height.

examples.name: Filled
examples.summary: Pre-populated selection showing the filled trigger label and the checked indicators.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid state applying the danger border and ring tokens.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled trigger; the dropdown cannot open.

examples.name: Chips
examples.summary: variant="chips" shows each selected value as a removable chip; chipLimit caps them with a +N more chip.

examples.name: Searchable
examples.summary: searchable types in the trigger to filter the options, Backspace removes the last chip, and allowCustom offers an Add row that emits create.

examples.name: ListStates
examples.summary: Pick a state, then open the list: loading, error and empty. The error says how to retry; reopening loads again.
